name: Javi
summary: Dabaoth-Kra に囚われていた Archimedean
> Javi was an Orokin Archimedean and prisoner in Dabaoth-Kra.
sections: Javi was described as a scrawny, hairless man who suffered from a dry skin disease and had tattoos of two serpents spiraling around each of his arms. As a former Archimedean, Javi was permitted to wear his white robe while imprisoned and was given a ceremonial hood during his execution.
